notes: Round 5 closes review-4 findings. MAJOR-A: only an `acked` chat.send landing later in the SAME pass, after the candidate failures, authorizes a discard; `duplicate` (previous-pass success or the in-process RecoveryGate acked cache) is explicitly not evidence, so held candidates are dropped without discarding, the cursor stays behind the first failure and the retry is armed. MINOR-B: held-candidate and uniform-failure accounting is a Map keyed by message id, so a refetched page cannot inflate the limit or double-fire onDiscard; an id that is held and then acks is removed from the held set rather than discarded. NIT-C: attempt-ledger cap eviction protects active entries (current message, per-conversation head-of-line blocker and most recent entry) and evicts only inactive ones by seq; an all-active overflow is kept and logged loudly instead of resetting a blocked message's counts. NIT-D: a channel that cannot be fetched or is not readable history is an explicit per-channel failure with a diagnostic - cursor untouched, pass incomplete, retry armed. Recovery still does not backfill threads/DMs (needs Discord thread enumeration, out of scope); their watermarks stay bounded by the quarantine cap. Every new test was verified to fail under a targeted source mutation. The full package run emits an expected session-rebind startup-failure diagnostic from its existing test scenario; the suite completed with zero failing tests.
